name: Nexus Power
old_description: From Manufacturer to Engineered Solutions: A Unique Sales Approach
about:
Nexus Power is based in South Salt Lake, Utah, and operates as a manufacturer’s representative and engineered-solutions provider across 11 Western states. The company does not disclose its founding year or ownership structure, but it presents itself as a collaborative organization built around five distinct divisions.

The firm’s five divisions—Utility/Renewables, Industrial, Commercial, Stock & Flow, and OEM—each maintain a dedicated director, a focused sales strategy, and local inside and outside sales teams. This structure allows Nexus Power to offer both technical sales representation and, through its Stock & Flow division, inventory management and product fulfillment. The company emphasizes a cross-divisional knowledge-sharing model that it says delivers innovative solutions for its partners.

Nexus Power serves customers in the utility, renewable energy, industrial, commercial, and original-equipment-manufacturer sectors. Its case studies reference work with manufacturers, distributors, and end users, indicating a broad customer base that spans the electrical power equipment supply chain.

The company states that its divisional model redefines the traditional manufacturer’s rep role by combining deep vertical expertise with the ability to leverage insights across markets. It positions this collaborative approach as its primary differentiator, aiming to exceed partner expectations through consistent support and engineered solutions.
